description: Update multiple transactions in a single call (1-500). Each entry must include `id` plus at least one writable field. Cannot be used to modify split or grouped transactions.

transactions.description: Array of partial transaction updates, each keyed by its `id`.

additional_tag_ids.description: Adds these tags to the existing transaction tags. Mutually exclusive with tag_ids.

amount.description: New amount, as a number or a string with up to 4 decimal places. Cannot be null.

category_id.description: Category ID. null clears the category.

currency.description: New three-letter currency code, e.g. usd.

custom_metadata.description: Arbitrary JSON object stored with the transaction.

external_id.description: User-defined external ID. The update fails if the transaction has no manual_account_id or another transaction already uses this external ID for that account.

id.description: ID of the transaction to update (required).

manual_account_id.description: Manual account ID. null disassociates the transaction from its account. Mutually exclusive with plaid_account_id.

notes.description: New notes, max 350 characters. An empty string clears the existing notes.

plaid_account_id.description: Plaid account ID. Mutually exclusive with manual_account_id.

recurring_id.description: Recurring item ID. null unlinks the recurring item.

tag_ids.description: Replaces all existing tags on the transaction. An empty array removes all tags. Mutually exclusive with additional_tag_ids.

name: update_transactions_bulk
